text.p: Taiwan share prices are expected to rebound on Monday after five straight days of falls, partly helped by expected gains in China-concept shares, brokers said.
On Saturday, the index ended down 24.28 points or 0.29 percent at 8,302.25. A 8,280-8,400 range was seen for Monday.

China-concept shares - Taiwanese companies with investments or investment plans in China - may rise after two Chinese vessels last weekend beecame the first to sail directly to Taiwan from rival China in 48 years, brokers said.
Taiwan has banned direct trade and transport links with China since a Chinese civil war split them in 1949.
